## Trust checklist

The project's credibility depends on these. Tick what applies, and say so plainly
if something is deliberately not applicable.

- [ ] No invented facts — prices, hours, ratings, reviews, awards and dietary claims
      all trace to a real source snapshot
- [ ] Provenance preserved (`website` / `owner` / `synthetic` stay distinct)
- [ ] Failures reduce coverage; they are never counted as "not mentioned"
- [ ] No causal claim that a content edit changed AI visibility
- [ ] Live, synthetic and recorded-replay results remain unmistakably labeled
- [ ] Historical runs, snapshots and artifact versions remain immutable
- [ ] No new autonomous publication, outreach or third-party listing write
